design_disposition: Mathematically sound under declared fixed-population, independent FN-only detection, correct positive repairs, and known lower-bound sensitivity assumptions. Stress cases intentionally violate calibration or independence and must be labeled accordingly.

exact_risk_definitions.conditional_unsafe_risk: unsafe_pass_probability / pass_probability, undefined if pass_probability=0; not bounded by delta in general.
exact_risk_definitions.expected_residual_sanity: E[K-Y] = K*(1-(n/N)*q), also valid in the proposed all-or-none model with the same marginal q; equal means do not imply equal tail risks.

formal_model.cdf: F_q0(K,y) = sum_h [C(K,h) C(N-K,n-h) / C(N,n)] sum_j=0..min(y,h) C(h,j) q0^j (1-q0)^(h-j), with feasible h support.
formal_model.detected_positive_count: Y | H ~ Binomial(H,q); no false positives; all Y detected positives repaired correctly once.
formal_model.population: N claims; fixed latent stale count K in 0..N.
formal_model.probability_claim: For independent q>=q0, P(K>U_q0(Y))<=delta, and P(pass and K-Y>6)<=P(K>U_q0(Y))<=delta. This is unconditional over sampling and detector randomization for one fixed population.
formal_model.residual_after_repair: R = K - Y, including undetected stale claims INSIDE the audited sample.
formal_model.residual_bound: B(y)=U_q0(y)-y; pass iff B(y)<=6. Otherwise withhold; no hidden full-inspection fallback.
formal_model.sampling: Uniform without replacement of n distinct claims, independent of latent labels and detector draws.
formal_model.upper_total: U_q0(y) = max {K in [y,N] : F_q0(K,y) > delta}. Search y..N, not y..N-n+y, because false negatives invalidate the latter feasibility limit.
formal_model.why_lower_sensitivity_bound_suffices: Y is stochastically nondecreasing in q and K, so inversion using q0<=q is conservative. Marginal sensitivity alone without independence does not establish this distribution.

implementation_hazards.fix: Search every K from observed y to N. Keep detector false negatives in residual K-Y.
implementation_hazards.issue: Hypergeometric-only inversion limits K to N-n+y and falsely treats negative audit labels as certainly current.

implementation_hazards.fix: Sum exact probabilities over every feasible Y state. Do not compute pass or unsafe risk using a single lower-tail cutoff.
implementation_hazards.issue: The release gate can be nonmonotone in Y, even though U(Y) is monotone.

implementation_hazards.fix: Include n=N anchors and label perfect-sensitivity assumptions explicitly; a census with fallible detection is not a perfect full scan.
implementation_hazards.issue: q0=1 naive audit misinterprets a census as perfect validation when actual q<1.

implementation_hazards.fix: Use actual mixture P(Y=y)=q*P(H=y)+(1-q)*1[y=0] when scoring. Do not score it with a binomial actual distribution or claim calibrated coverage applies.
implementation_hazards.issue: An all-or-none detector has the correct marginal q but violates independent detection.

implementation_hazards.fix: Declare q and q0 controlled simulation parameters. No inferred model sensitivity or semantic-validation guarantee. A future empirical calibration would need independent evidence and explicit calibration-error accounting.
implementation_hazards.issue: A calibrated-q0 result requires q0 to be a valid known lower bound, not a point estimate from the same labels.

implementation_hazards.fix: State this is an independent component study and do not imply the n64 row occurs after 12 discovery inspections in the old 64-claim workspace.
implementation_hazards.issue: The prior main study used a post-discovery pool of 52; this component sweep uses a fresh pool N=64.

implementation_hazards.fix: Report pass and withhold probabilities alongside unsafe-pass risk; charge exactly n detector calls. Do not compare safety while hiding the lower release rate.
implementation_hazards.issue: Withhold is an availability cost, not successful repair.

implementation_hazards.fix: Present K profiles and worst-K risk for each design. Label any uniform-K summary descriptive design averaging, never an operational failure rate.
implementation_hazards.issue: Averaging K uniformly gives an arbitrary population model.

correlated_all_or_none_q09_K64.actual_detector: Shared Bernoulli switch: all stale detections succeed with probability.9; all fail with probability.1.
correlated_all_or_none_q09_K64.assumption_violation: Detector errors correlated despite marginal sensitivity.9.

misspecified_q0_09_actual_q07.assumption_violation: q0=.9 is not a lower bound on actualq=.7.

naive_q0_1_actual_q09_K64.assumption_violation: Detector sensitivity was assumed1 while actualq=.9.

independent_n64_anchors.q0_09_nonmonotonicity: Y30 -> U37 -> B7 -> withhold; Y58 -> U64 -> B6 -> pass.

minimum_boundary_tests: q0=1 reproduces the ordinary exact hypergeometric upper count.
q0=0 gives U=N for all valid y: total bound vacuous. B=N-y may still certify if y>=N-6; actualq=0 alwaysY0 and cannot pass forN64.
n=N,q=q0=1 gives Y=K,U=K,residual0, pass1, coverage failure0.
K=0 gives Y0, no unsafe release, but withholding may still occur because absence is not proved cheaply.
All PMFs sum exactly to1; all probabilities in[0,1]; unsafe<=pass; unsafe<=coverage event probability under the stated gate.
For all calibrated independent grid rows, exact coverage failure<=1/20 and unsafe pass<=1/20.
q, q0 outside[0,1] and impossible N,n,y reject; exact rational q values9/10,7/10,1/2 avoid floating cutoff errors.
No sample/detector Monte Carlo is used; a complete rerun produces byte-identical exact output.
Maximum possible y is min(K,n) under actual distributions; inversion still searches candidateK throughN.
publication_recommendation: Freeze the component protocol and code before running; publish exact operating characteristics as a separately versioned study. Explain assumption violations, false-negative residuals and withholding costs in the abstract/results. It does not establish an empirical LLM improvement, novel theorem or production repair capability.
study_scope: Prospective noisy audit component extension; N=64 fixed latent binary staleness; no language-model calls, no empirical sensitivity estimate, no production validator inference, no new statistical theorem claim.
